message:
Update README with project layout details

Added project layout section to README with file structure and descriptions.
Add market-making game logic and UI components

Build Quantdle prototype: Wordle-style quant puzzles

Next.js app where each quant puzzle is split into steps that build to a
final answer, with 6 guesses per puzzle and green/yellow/grey feedback.

- Daily puzzle from a hand-checked bank; Practice mode generates puzzles
  with Claude at Easy/Medium/Hard/Expert
- Numeric answers are checked by a safe expression parser; misses go to a
  Claude judge that can award yellow for the right approach and writes a
  hint that doesn't reveal the answer
- Puzzles are sealed in AES-GCM tokens so answers never reach the browser
- Hints, show-your-work, share grid, stats, streaks, confetti, dark mode
- Falls back to the bank and rule-based judging without an API key
